result.summary: The main visual issue is a cosmetic flaw in the promotional banner for a pizza restaurant at the bottom of the screen, which displays an incorrect and confusing discount label.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card at the bottom of the screen displays a '-0%' discount badge.
issues.suggestion: Remove the '-0%' badge entirely, as a zero-percent discount provides no value to the user and appears as a placeholder or data error.
